`src/kana-strokes.js` is an adaptation under the same license: SVG path `d`
attributes were extracted in document (stroke) order into a JavaScript object.
The coordinates and stroke order are unchanged. The application renders these
paths with its own colors, guides and train. This notice concerns the KanjiVG
data and its adaptations; it does not relicense unrelated application code or
train illustrations. KanjiVG does not endorse this application.
